review_mode: inline five perspectives because complete diff exceeds2000 lines per review skill

findings.title: Re-enabling voice can leave target pace alerts disarmed
findings.issue: processProgress continues consuming tracker alerts while isEnabled=false or volume=0; enabling voice does not reset alert readiness, so the same excursion may never be spoken.
findings.suggestion: Restart only pace readiness when voice becomes audible; retain split progress and cover toggle/volume re-enable regressions.
findings.resolution: Pace-only readiness restart on toggle/unmute; existing split retained; both regression arguments passed in service suite.

findings.title: Legacy kilometer event exists only for tests
findings.issue: Production now exclusively emits actual split cues; legacy average-pace kilometer event and catalog entry are retained only by tests.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused event/catalog string and migrate queue/validation tests to real split cues.
findings.resolution: Removed unused event and catalog string; queue/validation tests now exercise actual split events; reference search clean.

findings.title: Use current WKApplication instead of deprecated WKExtension
findings.issue: New foreground completion branch referenced an API deprecated since watchOS9.2.
findings.resolution: Changed to WKApplication and verified by final standard build (exit 0).

findings.title: Custom settings header truncates title and consumes list viewport on 40mm Watch
findings.issue: Fresh XCTest failure PNG shows wrapped/truncated Feedback Settings and oversized custom Done row occupying much of sheet viewport.
findings.suggestion: Use native title/confirmation toolbar without nested NavigationStack; expose target value separately.
findings.resolution: Native title/confirmation toolbar, short localized Voice title and single-line target value. Settings UI test passed and fresh C17/C18 PNGs visually checked on owned 40mm Watch.

findings.title: SDK recommends asynchronous audio session activation
findings.issue: Watch simulator xcresult reports AVAudioSession synchronous activation can affect UI responsiveness when called on main thread. No UI test hang was attributed to audio activation.
findings.suggestion: Profile on real Watch and move activation/deactivation to serialized asynchronous lifecycle with cancellation guards.
findings.resolution: Deferred: not a mechanical change; async activation requires explicit stop/new-cue race coverage and real audio route validation. Does not block P1/P2 gate.

findings.title: Secondary heart-rate row clipped in default 40mm distance capture
findings.issue: Fresh C14/C15 capture shows bottom heart-rate row partly below viewport.
findings.suggestion: Keep primary km size; compact gaps and average-pace label; verify actual heart-rate frame and recapture.
findings.resolution: Kept 42pt primary km, compacted spacing and Avg Pace label with full accessible name. Default 40mm HR frame assertion passed; fresh C14/C15 visually verified.
